courseleaf.title: Medical Humanities (MDH)
courseleaf.text:
MDH 155 — Genetics, Identity, & Religion (4 units)

Course Description: Effects of new understandings of genetics on how different religions configure belonging, identity, and ethics.

  • Learning Activities: Discussion 3 hour(s), Extensive Problem Solving.
  • Grade Mode: Letter.
  • General Education: Arts & Humanities (AH) or Social Sciences (SS); World Cultures (WC).
  • This course version is effective from, and including: Fall Quarter 2026.
